title: Authorize legacy vocab deletion
summary: Codex needs Ben to authorize the later WP-M2-04 legacy vocab deletion workflow before any legacy vocab file or export is removed. This queue entry does not delete anything by itself. Approval lets Codex run the legacy-vocab reference audit, prepare the manifest, and open a destructive deletion PR only for items that the audit marks safe and Ben has authorized. Rejection keeps the legacy vocab exports in place and blocks that deletion step.

choices.label: Authorize deletion workflow
choices.codex_action: proceed with WP-M2-04 legacy vocab audit and later destructive deletion PR limited to approved safe items

choices.label: Do not delete legacy vocab
choices.codex_action: block WP-M2-04 legacy vocab deletion and keep legacy vocab exports in place

choices.label: Defer decision
choices.codex_action: leave WP-M2-04 legacy vocab deletion blocked pending further Ben review
